Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That’s it from the coverage of this game and well, we conclude this series as well. The hosts won the ODI series, while they share the spoils in the T20I series. Hence, Mohammad Nabi and Mahmudullah get presented with the T20I trophy, as the series ended 1-1. Both the teams get together for a group picture with the trophy placed in front of them. This shows the real spirit of this game, to be honest. We will see Bangladesh soon in action as the squad will travel to South Africa for 3 ODIs and 2 Test matches. Afghanistan, on the flip side, have no fixtures announced yet and have ample time to work on the T20 World Cup later this year. They will certainly use this time to focus on developing their young players and increase their bench strength. Till then, please feel free to follow some rollicking Test matches happening across the globe and let us not forget about the ongoing Women's World Cup, 2022 which is being held in New Zealand. Until next time, take care and goodbye!

Mohammad Nabi, the victorious skipper, is in for a chat. He says, the boys played really well. As a bowling group and showed great effort in the field as well. Adds that in the first game they did not show up with the blade and this time around the boys made sure to work on the mistake. Says they are trying to strengthen their squad by getting young players on the bench and their development is the priority.

Fazalhaq Farooqi is adjudged as the MAN OF THE SERIES. He is in for a chat. First of all he starts by congratulating everyone back at home for this victory and is really happy to perform against such a talented side. Adds, they just wanted to try their best and did just that.

Azmatullah Omarzai wins the MAN OF THE MATCH AWARD for his incredible effort with the ball. He thanks the Almighty and says he is really happy to deliver for the side. Mentions, he tried to put pressure with the dot balls and thanks god for believing in him.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, is in for a chat. He says, it was a good wicket to bat on and they failed to put on a good score on the board. Adds probably it was not a 150-run wicket but surely it was a 130-run wicket and was achievable. Says, he and Rahim tried to built a partnership and if they could’ve added a few more runs things could’ve been different. Says, the team needs to work on the fielding. Ends by saying, the team will play some series in June/ July to get them prepped up for the T20 World Cup.
Stay tuned for presentation...

Bangladesh have only themselves to blame for this loss. The hosts went into the chase looking for early wickets and well they manage to get one quickly. Although, they could've gotten two only if Nasum Ahmed was able to hold onto the catch of Hazratullah Zazai. Later, the bad form continued for Bangladesh in the field as they went on to drop a couple more catches. The trajectory of the game could've been different if those catches were taken. In the end, no bowler had a good day with the ball, as they leaked aplenty.

No hiccups for the visitors! Rahmanullah Gurbaz started off in a very hesitant manner. He was aggressive from the word go and lost his wicket pretty early on. Although, Hazratullah Zazai made the most of his reprieve and ended his innings with 59*, while Usman Ghani supported him really well in the middle. The pair stitched a 99-run stand for the second wicket and got their side closer to the finish line. In the end, Darwish Rasooli came in and applied the finising touches to get his side over the line and level the series.

What a top class performance by Afghanistan. First with the ball and later with the ball as well. After losing the first game by 61 runs, Afghanistan have comeback stronger and they have levelled the series with a win by a margin of 8 wickets. They will surely head back home with a smile across their faces. Bangladesh, on the other hand, did not have enough runs on the board and perhaps with some better fielding, things could've been different for the hosts.
SIX! ALL THE WAY! Darwish Rasooli wraps the game in style. Short and on off. Darwish Rasooli stands tall and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. AFGHANISTAN WIN THE GAME BY 8 WICKETS.
On off, pushed to cover.
Floated, on the pads. Darwish Rasooli flicks it to short fine leg.
Full and outside off. Darwish Rasooli drives it hard to cover but straight to the fielder.
SIX! SCORES LEVEL! Full length, on middle and leg. Hazratullah Zazai clears his front leg and tonks it over the long on fence. The fielder near the ropes leaps but only in vain.
Full length, on middle and leg. Darwish Rasooli flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hazratullah Zazai eases it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Zazai stays back and tries to pull it away but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Darwish Rasooli steers it down to third man for a single.

LEG BYE! A yorker, on leg. Hazratullah Zazai clears his front leg and looks to flick it away but misses. He gets pinged on his boot. Shoriful Islam appeals but the umpire is unmoved. The batters sneak a leg bye. Although, Mahmudullah takes it upstairs. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching outside leg. The review was taken much in hope by Mahmudullah.
Angled into the pads, Zazai flicks it to mid-wicket for a single. He will retain the strike.
On leg, Zazai tucks it to square leg.
Fuller, on off, Zazai leans in and defends it out.
Fuller, on leg. Darwish Rasooli flicks it through square leg for a single.
On off, blocked out.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Usman Ghani fought tremendously with some ongoing pain. He could not get his side over the finish line but made sure to get them closer to it. It is short and outside off. Usman Ghani waits for it and tries to cut it late. All he manages is to get a nick on it and Liton Das gathers the ball safely. Darwish Rasooli is the new man in.
Flatter and on the body. Hazratullah Zazai stays inside the crease and blocks it out.

SIX! SWEET! Hazratullah Zazai gets his FIFTY in some fine fashion. Tossed up, full, on middle and leg. Hazratullah Zazai gets low and slog-sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. Afghanistan now need just 13 runs.
Fuller, on off. Ghani leans forward and drives it to cover for one.
On off, pushed to cover for one.

SIX! BANG! Short and outside off. Hazratullah Zazai stands tall and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. The Afghanistan players are on their feet inside the dugout as an appreciation to this knock.
Fuller, on off, blocked out.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hazratullah Zazai eases it to long on for another single.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
Short and on off. Ghani punches it through covers for one.

FOUR! Bangladesh could not stay calm in the field. This is the third dropped catch. Floated, fuller, on middle and leg. Ghani gets low and slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep cover a lot of ground to right but is unable to grab the ball safely. It goes through his palms and into boundary.
On the stumps. Ghani guides it towards short third man.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Zazai slogs it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full length, wide outside off. Ghani drives it into covers but straight to the fielder. Afghanistan need 34 off 42 deliveries.
A length ball, outside off. Ghani shuffles across and tries to scoop it away but fails to get any blade on it.
Short ball, outside off. Zazai cuts it through point for one.
A length ball, outside off. Usman Ghani guides it through backward point. Mushfiqur Rahim runs to his right at third man and save a certain boundary with a well-timed dive. They take a single.
Back of a length, on leg. Ghani ducks under it.
Back of a length, outside off. Zazai cuts it through point for one.
On the pads, Zazai tucks it to square leg for one.

DROPPED! Afif Hossain drops a dolly in the deep. It is fuller, on middle and leg. Usman Ghani makes room and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket. Afif Hossain runs to his right, settles under the ball but spills it out in the end. The batters take one. Usman Ghani is still out there fighting on one leg.
Fuller, on off. Ghani pushes it to cover but not in the gap.
Slower through the air, outside off. Ghani tries to chase it but misses.
Full and wide outside off. Usman Ghani dabs it towards backward point.
FOUR! EDGY! Quicker, fuller and outside off. Usman Ghani throws his blade at it. The ball takes the outside edge and races away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length, on the fourth stump line. Hazratullah Zazai makes room and tries to cut it away but misses. The ball was not far away from the off pole.
Fuller, on off. Ghani pushes it to cover with soft hands and jogs to the other end. He is clearly struggling at the moment.
A slower length ball, on off. Ghani defends it with soft hands.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, on leg. Usman Ghani ducks under it and the umpire signals a wide.
On a length, outside off, Zazai opens the face of the bat late and steers it to third man for another single.
Full length, outside off. Usman Ghani guides it to third man for a single.
A length ball, on leg. Zazai gets it to square leg for one.
A short ball, on off. Ghani gets an inside edge onto the deck.

FOUR! Lucky this time. A length ball, outside off. Usman Ghani gets an outside edge and the ball races away towards third man and beats the man in the deep to find the boundary. Usman Ghani is clearly limping in the middle. A wounded soldier playing for his side. This shows how driven the lad is.

DRINKS! Even after losing an early wicket, Hazratullah Zazai and Usman Ghani have done a really good work to steady the ship for the visitors. Afghanistan now need 52 runs in 62 deliveries. They have full control over the chase at the moment with a good number of wickets left in hand. Bangladesh, on the flip side, need more than a miracle to get them over the line and seal the series.

FOUR! UP AND OVER! Usman Ghani doesn't time it well but he hit is safe enough to clear the infield. A short ball, on off. Ghani comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary. But wait, Usman Ghani is down on the ground, looks like he has some issue with his calf. The physio comes out to have a look.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Hazratullah Zazai pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one more.

JUST SAVED! Nasum Ahmed does not go for the catch and this could've been curtains for Usman Ghani. A short ball, on the body. Usman Ghani flicks it aerially towards fine leg. Nasum Ahmed does not charge towards the ball and let the batters take a single.
WIDE! Shoriful Islam bends his back and serves a short ball, on middle. Usman Ghani leaves it alone as it is way over his head. The umpire signals a wide.
A sharp bouncer, on middle. Ghani ducks under it and leaves it alone.
SIX! Two maximums to end the over. Hazratullah Zazai is starting to open up now. Fuller, on off. Zazai gets underneath it and slaps it over the long on fence. This is a much better hit.
SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Floated, full and on off. Hazratullah Zazai frees his arms and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Fuller, on leg. Ghani clips it to mid-wicket with soft hands. They take a quick single.
Full and outside off, an arm ball. Ghani gets a thick outside edge and it goes towards third man. The fielder cuts it out in time and gives away just two runs.
Short and on off. Zazai works it towards third man for one.
Floated, on middle andleg. Ghani flicks it away for one.
On the pads, Ghani flicks it to fine leg for one.
Back of a length, outside off. It flies off the deck. Ghani tries to chase it with an upper cut but only manages to connect with thin air.
On a length, on middle and leg. Hazratullah Zazai flicks it to square leg for another single.
Length and on off. Ghani guides it towards third man for a single.
Full length, on middle and leg. Zazai works it towards mid on for an easy single.
Full length, wide outside off. Usman Ghani reaches out and slashes it to deep point for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack now.

OH DEAR! How has this misses the stumps. A flighted delivery, full and just outside off. Hazratullah Zazai gets on one knee and tries to slog it away. Although he fails to get any blade on it and the ball misses the off pole by a whisker.
Fuller, on leg. Ghani flicks it to square leg for a single.
On the stumps. Ghani defends it to cover.
An arm ball, coming in a long way. Usman Ghani moves to the leg side and tries to work it away but misses.
On off, blocked out.
An arm ball, quicker and on the stumps. Ghani flicks it square on the leg side.

OUCH! Hazratullah Zazai the big man in on the ground. He gets hit in the box this time. A slower short ball, on middle and leg. Zazai clears his front leg and tries to whip it across the line. He misses and gets hit where no batter likes at it. Hazratullah Zazai will need some time to recover from this blow. Afghanistan are 34/1 at the end of Powerplay while Bangladesh were 33/2 at the same stage.

FOUR! UP AND OVER! Full length, on middle and leg. Hazratullah Zazai gets under it and lifts it over mid on. Mahmudullah does not reach it and the ball races away to the fence. This is boost Zazai's confidence a bit.
Shoriful Islam fires in a yorker, going down leg. Hazratullah Zazai tries to dig it out but misses and gets pinged on his right boot. Shoriful Islam pleads but the umpire says no.
A length ball, on the stumps. Hazratullah Zazai gets behind it and defends it out watchfully.
A short ball, on off. Usman Ghani guides it past backward point for a single.
A length ball, on off. Pushed out solidly.
On the pads, Usman Ghani flicks it through square leg for a single. A nice comeback by Nasum Ahmed after being hit for 10 runs off the first two deliveries.
On off, blocked out.

Floated, fuller, angled into the pads. Usman Ghani goes inside the crease and tries to flick it away but misses. He gets pinged on his pads and Nasum Ahmed appeals. The umpire is unmoved. Nasum Ahmed is convinced and asks the skipper to take the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that it is umpire's call on ball hitting the wickets. The ball just skids through in the end and kisses the outer part of the leg stump.
On off, extra bounce this time. Usman Ghani adjusts at the last moment and defends it out.
FOUR! Nicely played. A short ball, outside off. Ghani goes on the back foot and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
SIX! ALL THE WAY! This should ease some pressure. Tossed up, full and on off. Usman Ghani gets low and slog-sweeps it over the long on fence for a biggie.
On leg, Ghani flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Angled in, on middle and leg. Usman Ghani blocks it out safely.
On off, blocked out.
Full and on off. Zazai punches it to cover. The fielder does well to make a half stop and they take one.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Zazai clips it to the leg side.
Touch short, on off. it comes in and leaves Zazai with no room. But the batters does enough to defend it out.
Flatter, on the pads. Ghani stays back and glances it down to fine leg for a brace.
Angled into the pads. Zazai flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Really nicely played. Short ball, outside off. Zazai stands tall and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Full and on off. Zazai blocks it out.
On off, pushed to cover for one.
Floated, full and on off. Usman Ghani chips it awkwardly to the right of the bowler.
On off, defended out solidly.
FOUR! EDGY! Flatter and on middle and leg. Hazratullah Zazai gets an inside edge. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On off, blocked out.
Usman Ghani is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bangladesh get the early wicket that they were after. Tossed up, on off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz comes down the track and looks to heave it away. He get a top-edge on his attempt and Mahmudullah takes a sharp catch running backwards.
On off, pushed to cover.

Floated, fuller, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz shuffles across and tries to sweep it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. Mahedi Hasan appeals and the umpire raises his finger in a flash. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is not happy and takes the review instantly. The UltraEdge confirms Rahmanullah Gurbaz got some glove on it and the on-field decision was overturned.
Mahedi Hasan to bowl from the other end.
Around leg, Hazratullah Zazai blocks it to the leg side.
Full and on leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz flicks it to the leg side for one.
Fuller, on off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. The batters take two runs.

DROPPED! Floated, full and on off. Hazratullah Zazai gets low and tries the sweep shot. The ball takes the leading edge and goes miles up in the air. Nasum Ahmed calls for it and settles under it near the bowling crease. He has to wait a long, long time for the ball to get down and in the end spills it out. Hazratullah Zazai gets one out of it. Although, it could have been a comedy of errors as the ball spills out and moves past the stumps.
Flatter and on leg. Hazratullah Zazai gets back and defends it out somehow.
Floated, angled in, on middle and leg. Zazai defends it to the left of the bowler.
